description: Your always-on AI coworkers that move between text, calls, and Slack.

summary.one_liner: OpenDots is an open-source TypeScript template for building persistent AI agent workspaces ("Dots") that chat on the web and mobile, hold calls, work in Slack, and can each have their own isolated computer.
keywords: run ai agents on my own infrastructure
ai assistant for email and calendar
let ai save pages to my workspace
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a template you clone and run yourself, with a web app that includes Spaces (a library of nested, editable pages), specialist Dots configured with names, roles, instructions and permitted tools, and a per-Dot computer with browser, file and shell controls through OpenBot. Chat runs through CopilotKit with AG-UI streaming, and conversations are stored in CopilotKit Intelligence (hosted or local Docker). Dots can be connected to MCP servers and, optionally, Composio connected apps, with write actions gated behind owner approval cards. A call mode pairs realtime speech with a separate compute agent, and a managed Slack connection via Channels SDK lets users mention a Dot in a thread. Scheduled background tasks, Parallel-based public web research, and a Memory feature are also described.
use_cases: build a custom AI agent workspace
chat with an AI assistant that keeps context over time
let an AI agent act on email, calendar or GitHub with approval
talk to an AI agent by voice call
mention an AI agent in Slack threads
have an agent browse a site and save notes to files
draft and save documents with AI review before saving
how_to_run: git clone the OpenDots repository and cd into it
notable: Per-Dot permissions for browser, file, shell, research and tool access, with approval cards before risky actions run
Computer panel with live browser view, human takeover, files and terminal output, persisting profiles across stop/start
Pages are saved to a local SQLite workspace with autosave and revision checks to prevent stale overwrites
Scheduled runs that are interrupted by a worker failure are marked Interrupted and wait for explicit retry
Designed as a template to clone and customize rather than a hosted product
caveats: A template in early development, not a hosted product; you must run the app and configure its infrastructure
Conversations require a CopilotKit Intelligence project (hosted, local Docker evaluation, or licensed self-hosted), and a model provider key is needed before chatting
Computer tools need the separately built OpenBot services; an unconfigured template does not run commands on the host
Single-owner starting point: no shared editing, invitations, file uploads, or multi-user identity; Slack and spoken delegation were not yet verified against connected services per the README
Voice calls need separate speech provider configuration; public-web research sends queries to Parallel by default
